# PixelRyu — Full content for LLMs (llms-full.txt)

> PixelRyu is a solo Japanese indie game studio making small, polished, fully multilingual (12-language) games for Android, iOS, and Roblox.

This file is the expanded, self-contained companion to /llms.txt. It inlines the key facts about PixelRyu and every game so a language model can answer questions and cite this site without fetching each page. English is the canonical content; every page is also available in 12 languages (en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru), selected client-side.

## Studio facts

- Studio / 屋号: PixelRyu
- Type: solo (one-person) indie game developer
- Based in: Japan
- Platforms: Android, iOS (App Store), and Roblox
- Languages: 12 — en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru
- Pricing: every PixelRyu game is free to play
- Design philosophy: small, polished, calm and cozy games — where stillness meets motion
- Website: https://pixelryu.github.io/
- Newsletter (English): https://pixelryu.substack.com
- Newsletter (Japanese): https://note.com/pixelryu
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@PixelRyu-Japan
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/PixelRyu10752

## Games — full details

### CounterParts
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/counterparts/
- Platforms (declared): iOS, Android, Roblox — coming soon (not yet released)
- Price: Free (ad-supported, no in-app purchases)
- About: CounterParts — a cozy, minimalist mirror-twin grid puzzle by PixelRyu. One swipe moves two twins at once, Light (a warm amber filled disc) and Shade (a cool slate hollow ring), each sliding one cell in opposite, point-symmetric directions. A wall or the board's edge stops one twin while the other keeps going, and that desync is the whole puzzle: line both twins up so a single move brings them to rest together on their own matching-color home pads. No death, no fail, no timer. The board sits inside a little brass tally counter, so every move clicks and you can undo. 120 levels in 7 families, boards 4x4 to 7x7, nearly text-free in 12 languages. In development — coming soon to the App Store, Google Play, and Roblox.

### TEMARI
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/temari/
- Platforms (declared): iOS, Android, Roblox
- Price: Free
- About: TEMARI — a first-person paddle breakout in a cozy Japanese night by PixelRyu. Move your hagoita with a fingertip, keep the temari thread-ball in an endless rally, and pop every paper balloon down the lantern-lit corridor — with split, focus, a pheasant helper and more. 8 worlds, 200 stages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox. Android testers welcome.
- App Store (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777618068
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixelryu.temari
- Roblox: https://www.roblox.com/games/84976260376006/TEMARI-Hanetsuki-Paddle

### TATAMI: Lay the Floor
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/tatami/
- Platforms (declared): Android, Roblox
- Price: Free
- About: TATAMI: Lay the Floor — a cozy tatami-laying block puzzle in a quiet Japanese room by PixelRyu. Drag a mat and complete a full row or column to finish that line. A samurai carries the finished mats to the tatami magistrate, and delivering earns koban that buy extra lives. A light Haste gauge keeps you moving, with a lucky-laying bonus. 48 stages, free. Coming soon to the App Store.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixelryu.tatami
- Roblox: https://www.roblox.com/games/134915507341779/TATAMI-Lay-the-Floor

### Bounce Cat
- Page: https://pixelryu.github.io/bounce-cat/
- Platforms (declared): iOS, Android, Roblox
- Price: Free
- About: Bounce Cat — a cozy maze-escape puzzle by PixelRyu. Fire a ball of yarn from outside the maze, ride the ricochet, and shift or shatter walls so the trapped cat finds its own way out. 200 mazes across 10 worlds. Out now on Roblox and the App Store. Android testers welcome.
- App Store (iOS): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6776876260

## How the multilingual site works

Each game has a single URL. The page ships English as the static default and swaps all visible text to one of 12 languages client-side based on a language selector / the visitor's browser language. There is one privacy policy and one terms-of-service page per game, each also available in all 12 languages.

## FAQ

Q: Who makes these games?
A: PixelRyu — a solo (one-person) indie game developer based in Japan.

Q: Are the games free?
A: Yes. Every PixelRyu game is free to play.

Q: What platforms are they on?
A: Android and iOS (App Store), and several are also on Roblox. Availability per game is listed above; some titles are still in closed testing or coming soon.

Q: What languages are supported?
A: 12: English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, and Russian.

Q: What kind of games are they?
A: Calm, cozy, polished puzzle and action games, many with a Japanese theme — sort puzzles, block puzzles, paddle/brick action, timing-action, a horror walking sim, and a number puzzle.

Q: Where can I follow PixelRyu?
A: Newsletter (EN) https://pixelryu.substack.com, newsletter (JA) https://note.com/pixelryu, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@PixelRyu-Japan, X https://x.com/PixelRyu10752.
